name: Brian Heder
summary: An old-school Keys maritime smuggler who still moves illicit product through his boatyard and serves as Jason's rent-free landlord.
description: Brian Heder is a weathered Florida Keys contraband smuggler who has spent decades navigating shallow mangrove passages and outrunning maritime authorities. Operating an unassuming boatyard and marina that doubles as a staging ground for offshore drops, Brian provides Jason with dockage, safehouse accommodations, and logistical access to watercraft.
personality: Pragmatic, gruff, veteran sailor, distrustful of federal authorities.

seo.title: Brian Heder: Boatyard Smuggler & Keys Contact
seo.description: Profile of Brian Heder in GTA VI. Veteran smuggler, boatyard owner, and key maritime logistical contact for Jason and Lucia in the Keys.
